scope: networked source-free Rocky tool-image preparation only
finding: Docker.call buffered docker-exec stdout and stderr in pipes. SIGTERM could terminate the Python owner before finally, preserving the lease but losing already-emitted dnf transaction bytes; docker logs cannot recover exec output.
required_correction: Persist each command's stdout and stderr continuously from the first byte.
Route orderly SIGTERM and SIGINT through bounded container retirement and atomic receipt generation.
Retain the lease whenever terminal retirement is unproven.
Add real subprocess regressions that emit identifiable output, receive SIGTERM/SIGINT, and prove partial evidence survives; abrupt death must also leave emitted bytes recoverable.
accepted_observations: Preparation is separated from project inputs and has no source mount.
The implementation checks effective limits before start and restricts added capabilities to the listed RPM installation set.
Installed identities are probed, image commit follows container retirement, and failed containers are retained.
limitations: No execution release, build, module, guest, runtime or OS acceptance is granted.
